concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-development-resources-batch-processing-advanced-sftp-batch-files-batch-request-file-payout-request-file-payout-request]] — 2026-09-15 SFTP batch payout request sub-line schema for payout details, recurring type and card/bank/IBAN destination, with permission and example/table discrepancies.
warnings: Raw Recurring table says fixed Latest while examples use LATEST; raw Card table requires CVC but its sample row lacks a separate CVC-position value.
Payout request and batch-file validation do not prove payout authorization or funds delivery.

BankAccount table requires two-letter alphabetic bank-location and bank-name fields and describes optional two-letter check code, while sample uses numeric `20010020`, multiword `Postbank Stockholm`, and `Hameln` in those positions; do not treat sample as a validated payout row.
